description: Resume-level retrieval benchmark with realistic profiles, hard negatives, synonyms, negation, and multi-evidence requirements.

Mentored one graduate engineer through code reviews and weekly pairing sessions.
Built an internal React dashboard for support teams to inspect failed transactions.
Documented incident recovery steps, although production incidents were led by the on-call platform engineer.
Frontend engineer focused on customer-facing travel and booking experiences.
Developed React applications in TypeScript used by more than 80,000 monthly customers.
Built reusable form, modal, and navigation components documented in Storybook.
Improved keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels to meet WCAG 2.1 AA requirements.
Reduced the checkout JavaScript bundle by 28% using route-level code splitting.
Maintained a small Node.js service that aggregated availability data from internal APIs.
Worked with UX designers and researchers to test prototypes with customers.

Used GitHub Actions to run tests and publish preview builds for pull requests.
Partnered with backend engineers on REST API contracts and error handling.

Data analyst supporting finance, operations, and customer success teams.

Automated spreadsheet validation and CSV ingestion with Python and pandas.

Completed an introductory machine learning course and reproduced a tutorial notebook.
Have not trained, deployed, or monitored a machine learning model in production.
Scheduled transformations in Azure Data Factory using pipelines owned by the data engineering team.
Documented metric definitions and data lineage in the internal analytics catalogue.
Facilitated requirements workshops with finance controllers and regional operations managers.
Used Git for version control and participated in peer review of analytics code.
Platform engineer responsible for deployment tooling used by fourteen product teams.
Administered production Kubernetes clusters and created Helm charts for shared services.
Implemented continuous delivery pipelines in GitHub Actions with staged rollouts and rollback checks.
Built Prometheus alerts and Grafana dashboards for latency, saturation, and error budgets.
Led incident reviews and converted recurring failure modes into runbook automation.
Supported workloads running on Amazon EKS but cloud accounts and networking were managed centrally.
Provisioned development environments with Terraform modules maintained by the infrastructure group.
Coached three application teams on readiness probes, resource limits, and safe deployments.
Created Python command-line tools for release diagnostics and configuration validation.
Participated in an Azure migration assessment but did not deploy workloads to Azure.
Maintained service-level objectives and reported reliability risks to engineering managers.
Used Docker to package internal platform components and test them locally.
Product engineer working across web applications and internal customer-support tools.
Created HTTP services with Django REST Framework for subscription and account workflows.
Deployed services to Google Cloud Run and configured Cloud Monitoring alerts.
Built React and JavaScript interfaces for customer onboarding and plan changes.
Interviewed support agents and converted recurring issues into a prioritized delivery roadmap.
Presented technical trade-offs to product managers and customer operations leaders.
Implemented PostgreSQL schema changes and SQL queries for subscription reporting.
Used Docker for local development and automated tests in GitLab CI.
Contributed code reviews but have not formally managed or led an engineering team.
Completed AWS Cloud Practitioner training without using AWS in a production role.
Added structured JSON validation for inbound webhook events using Pydantic.
Reduced failed onboarding submissions by 21% after analyzing validation errors.

Commercial experience shipping production applications with Next.js.

Ability to communicate insights and gather requirements from business partners.
Ownership of Azure cloud infrastructure and production platform operations.
Production Kubernetes operations and continuous delivery experience.
